items.q: How much does a website cost?
items.a: A website starts at €450 (Start); a business website with several services starts at €750. I will tell you the exact price right after our conversation, before any work starts. The domain is paid separately; hosting is included in maintenance.

items.q: Who will own the website and domain?
items.a: You. The domain, hosting and email are registered in your name. If you ever decide to leave, you take everything with you, no questions asked.
It depends on the size of the project and how quickly content (texts, photos) is provided. A small website usually takes a few weeks. You get the exact timeline in writing with the proposal.

items.q: Can you help with the domain and hosting?
items.a: Yes. I will help you choose and set up a domain and hosting, and we will register them in your name.

items.q: Will the website look good on phones?
items.a: Yes. Every website is built to look good on phones, tablets and desktops.
I set up what Google needs to understand your website: page titles, descriptions, structure and speed. I don’t guarantee first place on Google — honestly, nobody can.

items.q: Will I be able to edit the content myself?
items.a: Yes. You can edit texts and prices yourself — or, if you prefer, I will do it for you.

items.q: Can you update my current website?
items.a: Yes. I can update your existing website or build a new one, keeping what already works well.

items.q: Do you only work with businesses in Kaunas?
items.a: No. I’m based in Kaunas, so we can meet in person there, but I also work remotely with businesses across Lithuania and abroad.

items.q: Do you maintain the website after launch?
items.a: Yes. For the first 3 months after launch, I fix anything that doesn’t work for free. After that, maintenance starts from €25 per month: hosting, backups, updates and small changes.
